definition: Matti Kalevi Pietikäinen is a Finnish computer scientist.
details: He is currently Professor (emer.) in the Center for Machine Vision and Signal Analysis, University of Oulu. His research interests are in texture-based computer vision, face analysis, affective computing, biometrics, and vision-based perceptual interfaces. He was Director of the Center for Machine Vision Research, and Scientific Director of Infotech Oulu.

explainer.lead: Matti Pietikäinen (academic) is a Finnish computer scientist. His work spans digital image processing.

contributions.name: He has authored over 350 refereed scientific publications, which have been frequently cited.
He has made pioneering contributions to local binary patterns (LBP) methodology, texture-based image and video analysis, and facial image analysis.

timeline.what: Pietikäinen received the Doctor of Science in Technology degree from University of Oulu, Finland, in 1982.
He was named a Highly Cited Researcher by Clarivate Analytics in 2018.
